selection_scope: one shared profile per dataset for clean and noisy runs

yelp2018.evidence: AU weight 1 and direct always-on CrossNorm (blend mu=1) follow the positive Yelp clean objective pilot; filtering uses the selected shared profile.

amazon-book.evidence: AU weight 5 and the best observed nonzero CrossNorm weight follow the Amazon objective pilot; filtering uses the selected shared profile.

lastfm.evidence: AU weight 0.1 and CrossNorm mu=0.2 follow the completed LastFM AU sensitivity; filtering uses the selected 4% profile.

ml-1m.evidence: AU weight 0.5 and CrossNorm mu=1 follow the completed ML-1M AU sensitivity; filtering uses the selected 0.5% profile.

arms.lightgcn: AU with no edge filtering and no CrossNorm
arms.filter_only: AU with structure-momentum hard filtering only
arms.full: AU with structure-momentum hard filtering plus CrossNorm blend

notes: AU momentum is the EMA of detached per-interaction normalized alignment squared distance from the exact optimization forward pass.
The batch-level user/item uniformity term is excluded because it has no unique per-edge attribution.
The configured train_decay is recorded for matched provenance but AU has no explicit L2 regularization term.
Filter and CrossNorm parameters are shared across noise ratios and are not selected using synthetic labels.
Learning rates are arm-specific: no-CrossNorm variants use 1e-3 and CrossNorm variants use 5e-4.
